prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 83.8%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Pick Friend Mascot Redesign: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a spotlight layout featuring an interactive mascot preview and playful animation highlights. (why: Adoption stage has a sharp drop (63.2% conversion rate) and takes 89s median time; a spotlight focus makes pet options clearer and more engaging.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Controls Onboarding Screen: Add a dedicated new onboarding screen right after home intro explaining shortcuts and tray options for controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: Support logs show multiple tickets from users confused about how to control or hide their pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Multi-Stage Taskbar Setup Flow: Introduce a taskbar readiness checklist flow on the waiting screen to guide desktop rendering permissions. (why: Home wait time is extremely long (mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported desktop pets failing to render or open.)
3: [adoption, layout] Compact Photo Upload Drop Zone Layout: Re-layout the custom photo upload screen using a compact layout with photo guidance tips. (why: Custom pet creation fails or looks wrong for multiple users, contributing to the adoption drop-off.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Control Shortcuts Intro Copy: Update the home intro text to explicitly detail hotkeys and right-click interaction options. (why: Users report confusion post-onboarding regarding how to interact with or hide their pet on desktop.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Safety Notice Hint: Display a hint on sign_in clarifying that signing in guarantees existing pets remain synced and recoverable. (why: 8 support tickets pertained to lost or reset pets upon re-authenticating.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Generation Time Indicator: Show progress and estimated time indicators alongside helpful tips while waiting for pet assets. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading users to believe the application froze.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Centered Path Selection Hub Layout: Change path selection layout to centered with a highlight badge on recommended pet creation paths. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; a centered visual hierarchy speeds up choice confidence.)
